objective: Produce canonical attributed relationship economics views as of one upper-exclusive cutoff by loading the explicit cohort once through the shared raw evidence owner, filtering raw facts once through the canonical as-of owner, and delegating grouping and relationship analytics construction to the existing attributed economics batch owner.

composition.attribution: exactly one canonical attributed economics batch projection over in-memory presentation and filtered economics evidence

rules: INS-004L remains sole owner of relationship cohort canonicalization and six canonical persistence reads.
INS-004K remains sole owner of canonical UTC cutoff validation and fact.occurredAt < asOfExclusive filtering.
Current presentation metadata is not historically filtered and remains current-state segmentation metadata.
Only filtered acquisition cost, premium, commission, and renewal facts enter relationship economics analytics.
Filtered durable outcome facts are not exposed by this attributed economics application.

The existing attributed economics batch remains sole owner of presentation uniqueness, relationship grouping, requested-cohort ownership validation, canonical requested order, and InsuranceAttributedRelationshipEconomicsView construction.
Relationships remain present even when no presentation exists or no economics facts survive the cutoff.
Optional premium or renewal effectiveAt never controls inclusion.
No new SQL, schema, persistence mutation, alternate cutoff rule, arithmetic division, status inference, currency conversion, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: created-at as-of combined acquisition performance snapshot
